cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take you for noodles. Nina's keeping her birthday dinner small.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small? She invited the whole choir.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's choosing people she sees every week. Pick our noodle place; I'll book.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We rehearse together every Tuesday. Read me her message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She wants an uncomplicated evening. I'll buy dinner; you can complain about her all through it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads an alternative dinner; A3 changes the exclusion explanation and gives B venue choice; A5 offers paid company accepting B complaints while still withholding the full harsh message.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 whole choir and B4 weekly rehearsal deliberately disprove A comforting accounts; the scene shows protective editing, not an objectively small or infrequent-contact guest list.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 supply actual contradictions and request the source message instead of passively accepting reassurance.

heightening.evidence: B4 message demand causes A5 a more accurate but softened phrase, followed by company that permits the complexity Nina avoids.

specificity.evidence: A1 Nina birthday and noodles, B2 choir and B4 Tuesdays establish social exclusion and current consolation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 edited explanation, meal offer and permission to complain act on B hurt; the evaluator-facing kindest-sentence label is removed.
